ai_text_001.text: Design Workflow: 1. **Biological Inspiration**: - Study natural structures (e.g., bird wings, termite mounds). - Identify adaptive mechanisms for wind and load management. 2. **Conceptual Design**: - Translate biological principles into architectural elements. - Use parametric modeling to explore forms. 3. **AI Optimization**: - Simulate wind and gravity loads using AI algorithms. - Optimize material distribution and structural efficiency. 4. **Prototype and Test**: - Develop scaled models for wind tunnel tests. - Refine the design based on performance data. 5. **Final Integration**: - Combine adaptive features with static elements. - Ensure durability and sustainability.
